name: WWE Heat
description: Feel the heat of the Attitude Era as WWE Superstars such as "Stone Cold" Steve Austin and The Rock compete in exclusive matches.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 01
videos.overview: On the premiere edition of Sunday Night Heat, Owen Hart and Intercontinental Champion The Rock represent The Nation in a Tag Team Match main event against Kane and Mankind. Edge continues to impress the WWE Universe by taking on Jeff Jarrett. Plus, D-Generation X stirs things up, an interview with WWE Champion Stone Cold Steve Austin, and more!

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 02
videos.overview: Mankind learns that looks can be deceiving when he calls out The Undertaker to face him in the main event. X-Pac takes to the ring to represent D-Generation X in a match against Light Heavyweight Champion Taka Michinoku. Plus, The Headbangers take on Southern Justice in a Tag Team Match, Dustin Runnels' moral crusade runs into Bradshaw, and more!

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 03
videos.overview: Speculation over Kane and The Undertaker's relationship causes problems for Stone Cold. DX faces Southern Justice in the main event.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 04
videos.overview: The Rock answers Triple H's recent challenge. X-Pac looks to settle a score with Jeff Jarrett. D'Lo Brown defends the European Title.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 05
videos.overview: As the gates of hell swing open at the site of SummerSlam, WWE Champion "Stone Cold" Steve Austin eagerly awaits the arrival of Kane and The Undertaker. Jeff Jarrett & Southern Justice send a message to X-Pac at the expense of Howard Finkel. Plus, Shawn Michaels tries to discover the identity of Sable's partner.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 06
videos.overview: With the destructive duo of Kane and The Undertaker on his side, Mr. McMahon takes to the ring to unveil his master plan to end "Stone Cold" Steve Austin's reign as WWE Champion. D'Lo Brown puts the European Championship on the line against Val Venis in the main event. Plus, Ken Shamrock faces Bradshaw in singles action.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 07
videos.overview: WWE Champion Stone Cold Steve Austin looks to give Ken Shamrock what he wants. X-Pac faces Jeff Jarrett in a Lumberjack Match main event.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 08
videos.overview: Kane and The Undertaker continue to prove why they are the most destructive force in WWE when they battle The Disciples of Apocalypse. D-Generation X takes on Jeff Jarrett, Owen Hart & European Champion D'Lo Brown in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Plus, Val Venis escalates his rivalry with Dustin Runnels to a personal level.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 09
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon looks to make Stone Cold Steve Austin meet Mark Henry inside a steel cage. Plus, Golga, The DOA, and many more in action!

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 10
videos.overview: Stone Cold Steve Austin goes on a destructive rampage before taking a ringside seat to watch The Rock face Jeff Jarrett in the main event.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 11
videos.overview: Stone Cold Steve Austin battles D'Lo Brown in the main event. Road Dogg Jesse James looks for retribution in a match against Jeff Jarrett.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 12
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon reminds Stone Cold Steve Austin of his responsibilities. Triple H presents the Intercontinental Title to Ken Shamrock.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 13
videos.overview: The deranged teams with a degenerate when Mankind & European Champion X-Pac unite to take on D'Lo Brown & Intercontinental Champion Ken Shamrock in the main event. Plus, Brian Christopher challenges Christian for the Light Heavyweight Championship, and Jeff Jarrett goes one-on-one with Golga of The Oddities.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 14
videos.overview: Amidst the turmoil within his family, Shane McMahon seizes an opportunity to express his vision for WWE on this special edition of Sunday Night Heat dedicated to Mr. McMahon. During a bout with The Godfather, The Undertaker receives a message from Kane. Plus, Val Venis refuses to share in Terri Runnels' problems.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 15
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon gives The Rock something to fight for. The Undertaker makes an example out of European Champion X-Pac.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 16
videos.overview: With the likes of Stone Cold Steve Austin, The Rock, The Undertaker and many more set to compete in the tournament to crown the new WWE Champion at Survivor Series, Mr. McMahon looks to get some 'Deadly Games' started early. Plus, Val Venis takes to the ring for singles action, Gangrel goes one-on-one with Steve Blackman, and much more!

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 17
videos.overview: Mankind unveils a present for Mr. McMahon. Val Venis challenges Ken Shamrock for the Intercontinental Championship in the main event.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 18
videos.overview: As the rivalry between D-Generation X and The Corporation intensifies, Mr. McMahon looks to recruit two unlikely individuals to join his stable of allies. The Undertaker and Paul Bearer vow to sacrifice "Stone Cold" Steve Austin for disrupting the building of his new Ministry. Plus, Mark Henry challenges X-Pac for the European Championship.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 19
videos.overview: Stone Cold Steve Austin takes a ringside seat to watch The Undertaker face Mankind in the main event. The Corporation battles The Brood.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 20
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon makes another guarantee. The Rock seeks medical attention before defending the WWE Title against Mankind at Rock Bottom.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 21
videos.overview: Tensions between D-Generation X and The Corporation reach an all-time high when WWE Champion The Rock and WWE Tag Team Champions Big Boss Man & Ken Shamrock battle Mankind in a Handicap Match main event. Plus, Tiger Ali Singh challenges X-Pac for the European Championship, and The Oddities receive an animalistic present.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 22
videos.overview: With Kane now The Corporation's personal weapon of destruction, Mr. McMahon orders The Big Red Machine to make an example out of European Champion X-Pac in the main event. Ken Shamrock & Big Boss Man defend the WWE Tag Team Titles against The Hardy Boyz. Plus, Terri Runnels and Jacqueline explain their new alliance.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 23
videos.overview: In effort to earn a chance to get some revenge on WWE Champion The Rock for his recent interference, Road Dogg Jesse James goes one-on-one with Test of The Corporation in the main event. Plus, cameras join Commissioner Shawn Michaels at his home for an exclusive interview, and Triple H faces off against Mark Henry.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 24
videos.overview: After guaranteeing to take action against newly crowned WWE Champion Mankind on Monday Night Raw, Mr. McMahon continues his rivalry with Commissioner Shawn Michaels by targeting HBK's mentor, Jose Lothario. Plus, Dan Severn shows everyone that appearances can be deceiving, and Triple H is forced to pay hard time in the main event with Big Boss Man.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 25
videos.overview: While the issues between D-Generation X and The Corporation continue to escalate, Mr. McMahon looks to test his strength against Chyna in an Arm Wrestling Match. Plus, The Brood's Edge and Gangrel take to the ring to face Jeff Jarrett and Owen Hart in a Tag Team Match, Goldust goes one-on-one with The Godfather, and more!

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 26
videos.overview: Hours before facing "Stone Cold" Steve Austin in the 1999 Royal Rumble Match, Mr. McMahon gives The Rattlesnake a chance to get things started early. As his "I Quit" Match against The Rock approaches, WWE Champion Mankind has to go one-on-one with a mystery opponent. Plus, The Undertaker vows to make another sacrifice to his Ministry of Darkness.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 27 (Halftime Heat)
videos.overview: Relive one of the most memorable confrontations from The Attitude Era as The Rock defends his WWE Championship against Mankind in an Empty Arena Match during Halftime of Superbowl XXXIII. Plus, the war between D-Generation X and The Corporation escalates when Chyna sets the record straight on her recent business decision.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 28
videos.overview: While Mr. McMahon guarantees to settle the score with "Stone Cold" Steve Austin and WWE Champion Mankind, The Corporation's newest asset, Chyna, makes her presence felt when Triple H and X-Pac compete in a Triple Threat Tag Team Match in the main event. Plus, Jacqueline and Luna meet to see who will challenge Sable for the Women's Championship.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 29
videos.overview: Just hours before facing Stone Cold Steve Austin in a Steel Cage Match at St. Valentine's Day Massacre, Mr. McMahon finds himself heartbroken after giving The Rattlesnake an opportunity to change his situation. Plus, Test takes to the ring to battle Viscera in singles competition, Debra makes Ivory a special offer, and much more!

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 30
videos.overview: In response to The Undertaker's recent actions against him, Mr. McMahon looks to light up this edition of Sunday Night Heat with a special declaration of war against The Phenom. Family ties end up costing Ken Shamrock when he goes one-on-one with The Godfather. Plus, Shane McMahon receives an unexpected challenge for his European Championship.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 31
videos.overview: Triple H is left seeing red when he accepts Chyna's challenge to meet one-on-one in the main event. The Brood looks to make its presence felt during a Tag Team Match between The Hardy Boyz and Public Enemy. Plus, an update on Goldust's relationship with The Blue Meanie, and The Undertaker battles Kurrgan of The Oddities.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 32
videos.overview: The road to WrestleMania XV spells trouble for The Corporation, as The Rock expresses his paranoia over Paul Wight officiating his WWE Title defense against "Stone Cold" Steve Austin. Tiger Ali Singh's attempts to humiliate American audiences earns him an unpleasant encounter with an Olympic Gold Medalist. Plus, The Acolytes battle Public Enemy.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 33
videos.overview: As WrestleMania XV continues to draw near, tensions escalate between Mankind and Paul Wight heading into the biggest show of the year. Jim Ross and Dr. Death Steve Williams take exception to Tiger Ali Singh's lack of discretion. Plus, The New Age Outlaws take to the ring for action, Test goes one-on-one with D'Lo Brown, and much more!

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 34
videos.overview: When dissension within the ranks of The Corporation leads to a confrontation between Big Boss Man and The Rock, The Undertaker's Ministry of Darkness takes advantage of the situation. Hardcore Holly gets a ringside seat to witness Al Snow and Billy Gunn's Hardcore Match. Plus, "Dr. Death" Steve Williams faces The Hardy Boyz in a Handicap Match.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 35
videos.overview: As the countdown to WrestleMania XV draws near, Mr. McMahon adds a stipulation to The Rock's upcoming WWE Title defense versus "Stone Cold" Steve Austin. Big Boss Man discovers the horror that awaits him inside the fabled Hell in a Cell with The Undertaker. Plus, a Battle Royal determines the two challengers for the WWE Tag Team Titles.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 36
videos.overview: Following the abduction of Stephanie McMahon on Raw, Mr. McMahon and his daughter are joined by Jerry Lawler in their home to discuss the horrors they've suffered at the hands of The Undertaker and his Ministry of Darkness. Plus, Kane challenges Jeff Jarrett & Owen Hart for the WWE Tag Team Titles in a Handicap Match in the main event.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 37
videos.overview: X-Pac and Kane defend the WWE Tag Team Championship against The New Age Outlaws and the duo of Jeff Jarrett and Owen Hart in the main event. While holding "Stone Cold" Steve Austin's WWE Championship hostage, The Rock gears up to go one-on-one with D'Lo Brown. Plus, Ken Shamrock competes in singles action, and Droz faces The Big Boss Man.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 38
videos.overview: As the world buzzes over Shane McMahon's betrayal of his own family, The Boy Wonder looks to continue asserting his control over WWE by making an announcement that spells trouble for "Stone Cold" Steve Austin. X-Pac finds himself in a lonely position when he and Kane are scheduled to defend the WWE Tag Team Titles against The Rock & Triple H.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 39
videos.overview: Hours before "Stone Cold" Steve Austin and The Rock battle for the WWE Championship at Backlash, Shane McMahon takes to the ring to announce a special stipulation for the match. Big Boss Man and Test find themselves at each other's throats after competing in a pair of singles bouts. Nicole Bass joins Val Venis to go up against D'Lo Brown & Ivory.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 40
videos.overview: After putting his Corporate Ministry in a position of power heading into Over the Edge, Shane McMahon issues a challenge to his father. The bonds of D-Generation X continue to weaken following a Tag Team Match between The New Age Outlaws and the duo of D'Lo Brown & Mark Henry. Plus, Darkness falls over Big Show when he calls out The Undertaker.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 41
videos.overview: The treachery of Billy Gunn continues to cause the once powerful faction of D-Generation X to fall apart when Road Dogg Jesse James goes one-on-one with his former ally and leader of DX, Triple H. Plus, tensions between The Union and The Corporate Ministry explode after The Rock sends a message to his rivals.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 42
videos.overview: The power struggle between The Corporate Ministry and The Union continues to escalate on the road to Over the Edge. While X-Pac squares up with D'Lo Brown, Kane prepares to face off against Mark Henry in singles competition. Plus, Road Dogg Jesse James competes against Hardcore Holly, and Droz & Prince Albert battle Christian & Gangrel.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 43
videos.overview: While the WWE Universe awaits "Stone Cold" Steve Austin's WWE Title defense against The Undertaker at Over the Edge, Mr. McMahon throws a wrench into a plot masterminded by his son, Shane. Hours before they meet in singles competition, The Rock sends a message to Triple H. Plus, Goldust and The Blue Meanie take on The Hardy Boyz, and more!

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 44
videos.overview: After feeling robbed of the WWE Championship at Over the Edge, "Stone Cold" Steve Austin issues a challenge to his nemesis, The Undertaker. Plus, X-Pac, Ken Shamrock, Hardcore Holly, and many more gear up for action in a series of matches to qualify for the 1999 King of the Ring Tournament.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 45
videos.overview: Chyna looks to make history by trying to be the first woman to enter the King of the Ring, but she must first defeat Val Venis in the main event. After taking to the ring to defend the Intercontinental Championship against Mark Henry, Jeff Jarrett sets his sights on targeting Ken Shamrock. Plus, The Brood sends a bloody message to The Acolytes.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 46
videos.overview: Chaos breaks out when Road Dogg & Ken Shamrock prepare to take on Billy Gunn & Chyna. The Brood looks for vengeance against The Hardy Boyz & Michael Hayes. Plus, Test challenges Jeff Jarrett for the coveted Intercontinental Title, and The Acolytes defend the WWE Tag Team Championship against D'Lo Brown & Mark Henry.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 47
videos.overview: As the 1999 King of the Ring Tournament approaches, the eight participants take to the ring to compete in a pair of Four Corners Matches where the two winners will go head-to-head in the main event. Plus, with his reign as WWE Champion threatened, The Undertaker sends an unmistakable message to The Great One.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 48
videos.overview: Hours away from King of the Ring, the McMahon's are faced with a dangerous proposition by WWE Commissioner Shawn Michaels. Big Boss Man is treated to a lesson in tough love when he faces two members of The Corporate Ministry. Plus, The Hardy Boyz battle Edge & Christian in a Tag Team Match, and The Rock sends a message to The Undertaker.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 49
videos.overview: The Undertaker seeks blood in exchange for gold with a challenge to face "Stone Cold" Steve Austin for the WWE Championship at Fully Loaded. The unusual duo of X-Pac & Kane take on The Hardy Boyz. Plus, Road Dogg battles Big Show in singles competition, Al Snow challenges Mideon for the European Championship, and much more action!

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 50
videos.overview: With a perceived target on his back, Big Show makes his presence felt during a No Holds Barred Match between Bradshaw and Kane. The Rock comments on his upcoming battle with Triple H at Fully Loaded. Plus, The Hardy Boyz defend the WWE Tag Team Titles against Droz & Prince Albert, and The Brood takes on members of The Corporate Ministry.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 51
videos.overview: After being realigned with Kane, The Undertaker and his formerly estranged brother look to get some revenge on the Big Show during his main event battle with Triple H. Road Dogg challenges Jeff Jarrett for the Intercontinental Championship. Plus, The Acolytes battle Prince Albert & Droz in a Tag Team Match.

videos.title: Sunday Night Heat 52
videos.overview: Triple H gives some rare insight in a controversial interview. The Undertaker looks to start his battle with Stone Cold Steve Austin early.
